issue_request: FHIR-18339 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Binary technical correction for STU3. It reported that the Binary advanced-read bullet about finding content size before retrieval was missing the closing parenthesis after the HEAD reference.

Later same-line grammar work for FHIR-18340 was applied by 81bcefb32e2f34e958de8b4f4bfd35cf8c6f2f20, and b74ceb8fe96fa4cd4303031371457fceaee5ff7b corrected the resulting "hough" typo. No FHIR-18339-tagged historical commit was found, but the requested non-substantive correction is present in current source history.
additional_context: Binary is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/binary/binary-notes.xml is in current build scope. The current source says "Finding the size of the content before retrieving it (though this can be achieved using a HEAD request)" with the closing parenthesis present. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-18340 audit for the related same-line grammar issue, and quoted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
